# Jermain C. Kaminski

> Associate Professor of Entrepreneurship and Innovation at Maastricht University School of Business and Economics. Research on causal inference and machine learning for the decisions founders, investors and strategists make, and on the economic complexity of software. Co-founder of the Causal Data Science Meeting and Moviegalaxies; advisor to Texterous. Poets&Quants Best 40 Under 40 MBA Professors, 2024.

Three pillars of current research:

- Causality in strategic decision making: causal diagrams that make a strategy's theory of value explicit; causal discovery and structural causal models that test it.
- Machine learning and simulacra in entrepreneurship: multimodal prediction of venture outcomes; silicon samples that simulate customer feedback before a product exists.
- Economic complexity of software: with Juhász, Wachs and Hidalgo, measuring the complexity of the code that countries produce and how it relates to their development (Research Policy, 2026).

- Predicting outcomes in crowdfunding, Small Business Economics, 2020
